description: Frame-time benchmark of the whole mod: the same save, speed and camera pan with ApexRadiance.asi left out (off) and installed with the tester's settings (on). Read FPS, frame time p50/p99 (1% low = 1000 / p99), frames over 50 ms per minute and visible freezes. Run with -AB -Profiler Both. Both frame limiters are lifted for the run (Apex's fps_limit 0, Sims3SettingsSetter's precise limiter at 1000), so a frame-rate cap does not hide a difference.
